prompt: Create a sophisticated vertical 4:5 cinematic fine-art portrait of a young South Asian woman seamlessly integrated into a vintage watercolor and mixed-media editorial artwork. Show exactly 1 woman from mid-torso upward, positioned slightly right of center, wearing a loose black crewneck sweater, with long dark tousled hair and soft curtain bangs. She turns her face gently upward toward the left with a calm, dreamy half-smile, natural skin texture, delicate realistic facial detail, and warm rim light catching her hair and cheek. Blend photorealistic portrait lighting with hand-painted watercolor edges, ink splatters, sepia paper texture, charcoal smudges, and torn-collage softness. The background is an aged cream parchment canvas with a misty alpine mountain range, dark pine forest, and large muted ochre sun rising behind her upper right shoulder; include exactly 8 small black bird silhouettes flying across the upper sky. Add botanical silhouettes on the right edge and lower right foreground, subtle handwritten manuscript texture behind them, faint architectural sketch lines and ink stains on the left, a dotted halftone pattern in the lower left, and watercolor washes that dissolve around the woman’s shoulders and bottom edge. Place a small handwritten quote on the left side reading Be your own muse. The world will adjust. in black ink, arranged over four short lines. Use a refined editorial composition, muted warm beige, sepia, charcoal black, smoky gray, and faded ochre, cinematic depth, soft atmospheric haze, high-detail face, organic paint blooms, and no modern objects, no extra people, no watermark, no frame.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的 4:5 垂直构图电影感艺术肖像，将 一位年轻的南亚女性 无缝融入复古水彩与混合媒介编辑艺术作品中。画面仅展示 1 位女性，从躯干中部向上取景，位于画面中心偏右位置，身穿 宽松的黑色圆领毛衣，留着凌乱的长深色头发和柔软的法式刘海。她脸部轻微向上转向左侧，带着平静、梦幻的半微笑，展现自然的皮肤纹理、细腻逼真的面部细节，以及捕捉在发丝和脸颊上的温暖轮廓光。将写实肖像光影与手绘水彩边缘、墨迹飞溅、棕褐色纸张纹理、炭笔涂抹以及撕裂拼贴的柔和感融为一体。背景为做旧的奶油色羊皮纸画布，其右上方肩部后方升起 朦胧的阿尔卑斯山脉、深色松树林和巨大的柔和赭色太阳；在上方天空中加入 8 只飞翔的小黑鸟剪影。在右侧边缘和右下前景添加植物剪影，其后方带有微妙的手写手稿纹理，左侧有淡淡的建筑草图线条和墨渍，左下角有圆点半色调图案，水彩晕染在女性肩部和底部边缘自然消散。在左侧放置一段简短的手写引语，内容为 Be your own muse. The world will adjust.，以黑色墨水书写，分为四行排列。采用精致的编辑构图，使用柔和的 暖米色、棕褐色、炭黑色、烟灰色和褪色的赭色，营造电影级景深、柔和的大气朦胧感、高细节面部、有机的颜料晕染效果，画面中不包含现代物品、额外人物、水印或边框。
